vision.reconciliation_explanation: The report value of 0.3762 is the empirical micro-averaged recall (874 TP / 2323 GT) evaluated at the operational threshold conf=0.25, IoU=0.50. The JSON overall value of 0.3440 is the unweighted class-averaged macro-recall reported directly by Ultralytics model.val(). Both are valid under their respective definitions.

audio.root_vs_speaker_analysis: Audio root_source identifies independent parent recordings/utterances (745 roots total, 207 roots in test set). However, roots do NOT imply 745 distinct human speakers; multiple parent recordings share underlying neural voice engines or speakers. Cross-split isolation is guaranteed at the recording level (zero exact recording leakage), but not at the speaker level.
